blind.B1: Yes. Voluntary wheel-running training vs sedentary in chow and HFD mice (S4.3.1.p1, S2.2.p1). Exercise-labelled samples: the 30 'training' libraries (grp CDtr/HFDtr, 5 mice x 3 tissues each), controls CDsed/HFDsed (S4.3.2.p1: 5 mice per group, 3 tissues = 60 libraries).
blind.B2: Per tissue (scWAT, vWAT, SkM triceps), three comparisons: obesity (HFD vs chow, sedentary), training (chow train vs chow sed), rescue (HFD train vs HFD sed), n = 5 mice per group (S2.2.p1, S4.3.2.p1, TAB1).
blind.B3: The same 20 mice contribute one library to each of the three tissues (title label e.g. SC3.scWAT/SC3.vWAT/SC3.Tricep). Within a tissue each mouse has one library, and tissues are analysed separately (S4.4.1.1.p1 'for each tissue'), so no blocking is needed. Candidate key = title label without the tissue suffix; the expression check does not support it (r 0.07, status not_supported) and it is not needed.
blind.B4: Paper says only: 'for each tissue ... differential gene expression analysis for our three comparisons was carried out using R package DESeq2' (S4.4.1.1.p1); it does not say whether the four groups were fitted jointly or each pair alone.
blind.B5: 'We called significant DEGs at an adjusted p value cutoff of 0.05' with IHW-adjusted p and ashr-shrunk fold changes; no fold-change cutoff (S4.4.1.1.p1); 'corrected p < 0.05' (S2.2.p1). Counts per tissue: 568 scWAT, 562 vWAT, 256 SkM (TAB1). Gene filter: 'genes with a count greater than 10 in all the samples were retained'.

checks.evidence: Exercise arm present (grp CDtr/HFDtr); S4.3.1.p1, S2.2.p1; suitability verdict analyzable.

grp levels 15/15/15/15 = 5 mice x 3 tissues, per tissue 5 per group matching S4.3.2.p1; exact match on bracketed title label, label prefix SC/TC/SH/TH agrees with treatment field; controls are the paper's own (training vs CDsed, rescue vs HFDsed).
design contrasts: treatment CDtr vs control CDsed, HFDtr vs HFDsed, HFDsed vs CDsed, as in S2.2.p1.
Pairing candidate flag is across tissues only; tissues are never compared and each tissue has one library per mouse (covariance record, S4.4.1.1.p1). Expression check not_supported.

One DESeq2 fit per tissue on all 20 samples (~ grp); the paper does not say joint vs pairwise (S4.4.1.1.p1). Counts under the primary filter differ from TAB1 for scWAT rescue (85 vs 132), but the sum-filter sensitivity (139) shows the filter, not the fit, drives the gap.
Both sedentary and training mice were singly housed (S4.3.1.p1); library-prep subpool (two pools of 15, S4.3.2.p1) is not deposited and the record says so; one sex.
Integer .intCt tximport counts kept, .l2cpm dropped; DESeq2 on counts as the paper; frac p>0.9 about 0.06-0.11, no pile-up near 1.

padj < 0.05, no fold-change rule, non-inclusive, transcribed exactly (S4.4.1.1.p1). The flag that padj<0.1 gives 133 vs paper 132 for scWAT rescue is not itself recorded, but the BH-for-IHW deviation and the filter reading are, and the sum-filter run (139 at padj<0.05) explains the gap without changing the rule.

HANDBACK table compares the same contrasts per tissue at padj<0.05 against TAB1. The primary run uses the literal 'count > 10 in all samples' filter, which the record itself shows removes the paper's named DEGs (Dbp, Tef, Nr1d2, Per3, Thbs1, Cdkn1a); the sum filter fits better in 5 of 9 cells and worse for SkM training (24 vs paper 92). Both are reported, so no claim exceeds the numbers.
No stop or refusal; all three tissues executed.

human_items: Open policy: which threshold/filter reading to treat as primary when the paper's numbers fit another reading (literal all-sample count>10 filter vs total count>10 sensitivity; padj<0.1 closest for scWAT rescue).
Open policy: joint (~ grp) vs pairwise fits when the paper is silent; only the joint fit is reported.
summary: 该案例的分析决策与论文一致:三个组织各自拟合,对比为 training、rescue、obesity,方向正确,n=5/组,阈值为 padj<0.05 且无倍数变化限制。同一只小鼠的三个组织从不相互比较,因此无需配对。主要差异来自 IHW 改为 BH 和低计数过滤的两种读法,均已记录并给出敏感性分析;联合模型与两两模型的选择、过滤读法的主次属于未决的策略问题。
